name: Yến sào
summary: Swiftlet nests from the bay islands, Hòn Nội and Yến Island. The island restaurant serves dishes made from the nests, and people take home raw nests, cleaned nests, and nest drinks, including Sanest.
origin: Islands in Nha Trang Bay. Hòn Nội, also called Yến Island.
howToEat: The island restaurant serves dishes made from the nests. People take home raw nests, cleaned nests, and nest drinks, including Sanest.
A cooled cup of thoroughly cooked nest is taken between about 8 and 9 in the evening, after lying down around 7, then a rinse with warm water.
where: Hòn Nội, also called Yến Island.
seoTitle: Yến sào — swiftlet nests from Nha Trang Bay
